note: Draft crop traits on simple 1 (low) to 3 (high) scales, from general southern-NSW agronomy. Every value must be checked against the NSW DPI Winter Crop Variety Sowing Guide and GRDC GrowNotes before use; see docs/methodology.md.

traits.water_use: Seasonal water use, 1 low to 3 high
traits.frost_sensitivity: Yield loss risk from frost at flowering and early grain or pod fill, 1 low to 3 high
traits.heat_sensitivity: Yield loss risk from heat (32 C and above) at flowering and grain fill, 1 low to 3 high
traits.ground_cover: How well the crop and its residue keep the soil covered across the year, 1 low to 3 high
traits.cereal: Cereal (hosts the same root and leaf diseases as wheat)
traits.perennial: Lives for more than one year
traits.market: Main product group, used to count how many different markets the rotation sells into
